about: Out-of-sample prices over years for strategy tests at the SP (the owner, 4 Nov 2026: 'keep working continuously' until five profitable strategies; 'fundamental is always just to get the most accurate closing price'). The live model's recipe (every engine block card-safe, the race simulator, the weight block, log(BSP), rescaled to the SP book) and the same features on the softmax win objective, each fitted once on 2021-2023 and pricing every race from 1 Jan 2024: rules at the SP with a price limit (Betfair's limit-on-close, matched at the SP or not at all) are scored on these, chosen on 2024 and confirmed on 2025-26.
